description: Maps text to scripts using a built-in Unicode block table (Latin including Vietnamese, Greek, Cyrillic, Hebrew, Arabic, Indic scripts, Thai, Lao, Khmer, Myanmar, Georgian, Armenian, Ethiopic, Hangul, kana, Han, symbols, emoji). Pass `text` and optionally `fonts` as a comma-separated family list. Returns blocks present with counts and sample characters, the scripts needed, which listed families are known to cover each (from a small table of common fonts, with Noto per-script families recognised), gaps with a suggested Noto family, and notes on Han unification and RTL. Font coverage is from general knowledge of common fonts and varies by version and OS, so confirm in the font file; unknown fonts are reported as unknown. Nothing is rendered.

fonts.description: Comma-separated font-family list, e.g. `Inter, Noto Sans JP, sans-serif`.

text.description: Sample copy in every language you ship.

name: check_font_coverage
title: Font coverage check
